Rae (Marketing): Hey team—final draft for the product launch blog (Optimize: inference cost toolkit) is up. Need: legal quick-pass on hero claims, growth check for headline variants + tracking, product sign-off on benchmark appendix, and ops confirmation for HubSpot -> SDR routing. Want to publish Friday morning if all green. :eyes:

Sam (Growth): Quick asks: can we get 2 short headline variants (12-15 words max) and a clearly labeled CSV for the benchmark so analytics can import? Also prefer utm_campaign=optimize_release_q2 and add param ab_test=hero_v1|hero_v2.

Rae (Marketing): Headlines drafted: A) "Smarter serving that cuts inference spend" B) "Shrink token costs up to 3x while keeping latency tight" CSV link pasted in Drive.

Elena (Legal): I can do a fast review. Replace any absolute phrasing like "up to" needs evidence—keep it "observed up to" and cite the appendix table. Also remove 'guaranteed' and 'instant'.

Tom (Product): For the appendix, include the exact test harness: Dedicated A100x4, seq_len=1024, model=rw-opt-13b-quant, batch_target=64; distribution: 50/30/20 short/medium/long. We ran 5 repeats, median reported. I'll paste the snippet.

Tom (Product): ```
Test harness: Dedicated A100x4
Model: rw-opt-13b-quant
Seq len: 1024; batch target: 64
Prompt length distribution: short(50 tokens)=50%, med(200)=30%, long(800)=20%
Runs: 5, metric: median cost per token, latency p95 reported
```

Nina (Ops): For HubSpot routing: confirm the form id and the property keys you will emit so we can map to the SDR queue. Suggest: form_id=optimize_launch_reg, properties: utm_campaign, ab_test, lead_source, interest_area. We can create a workflow to tag and push to SFDC.

Rae (Marketing): Confirm form_id=optimize_launch_reg. Emitting properties: utm_campaign=optimize_release_q2, ab_test=hero_v1|hero_v2, lead_source=blog, interest_area=cost-optimization. Will post JSON mapping in 30m.

Sam (Growth): also add an experiment tag 'headline_variant' to the payload so we can route winners to newsletter segment.

Rae (Marketing): added.

Elena (Legal): Minor edits I recommend: hero line should read "In our tests, we observed up to 3x lower inference cost on long-tail requests (see appendix)", and add the benchmark methodology parenthetical after the hero. Send me the final line + 1-paragraph justification and I'll clear tomorrow AM.

Rae (Marketing): Updated hero copy per legal: "In our tests, we observed up to 3x lower inference cost on long-tail requests (see appendix: benchmark methodology)." Drafting 1-paragraph justification now.

Tom (Product): Product ok with wording and methodology. Ops: once Rae posts mapping JSON I'll confirm SFDC queue mapping.

Nina (Ops): good, we can create workflow and push to SFDC queue "AE_Optimize_Launch". Need final property keys.

Rae (Marketing): Posting mapping JSON: ```
{
  "form_id": "optimize_launch_reg",
  "properties": {
    "utm_campaign": "optimize_release_q2",
    "ab_test": "hero_v1",
    "headline_variant": "v1",
    "lead_source": "blog",
    "interest_area": "cost-optimization"
  },
  "sfdc_queue": "AE_Optimize_Launch",
  "workflow_tags": ["launch","optimize","blog"]
}
```

Sam (Growth): Looks good. Make sure CMS uses headline_variant placeholder so we can flip. Also schedule a 48hr winners analysis.

Elena (Legal): Received the hero + one-paragraph justification. Quick pass granted pending the appendix link. I'll sign off tomorrow morning.

Rae (Marketing): Appendix CSV link: drive.google.com/open?id=1xOptimizeCSV. Added benchmark snippet and test harness.

PublishBot: NOTE: If all approvals completed by Thu 18:00 PT, publish window Fri 09:00 PT is reserved. Otherwise publish will be queued for next available slot.

Tom (Product): Confirmed on routing and metrics.

Nina (Ops): I'll create the HubSpot workflow once the JSON is approved and send a verification link.

Rae (Marketing): Thanks all. I'll post final approved copy + CMS save when legal confirms tomorrow AM. :rocket:
